name: Rising Rent
text: The landlord counts the coins twice. Rent up 10%.

name: Hungry Sellers
text: More cursed objects walk through the door.

name: Short Days
text: The sun sets early. The day is 7% shorter.

name: Quiet Tells
text: Curses hide better. Tells show 15% less often.

name: Light Sleepers
text: Something wakes sooner. The wake threshold drops 10%.

name: Closed Lots
text: No sealed lots at the Midnight Table. Rent up 10% again.

name: Thin Pockets
text: You start with 25% less cash. Sellers drive harder bargains.

name: The Shop Remembers
text: You start with a cursed object. Wakes leave more Dread.
